steps: Buy extra firm tofu and freeze it. It changes the texture of the tofu and makes it more spongy
Defrost the tofu and slice the block in half.
Marinade for at least 30 minutes. The marinade is: 1/4 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce, and 1 tablespoon umami seasoning from Trader Joe's.
Heat your smoker to 250°F, brush the tofu with oyster sauce and then rub with the BBQ rub of your choice.
Smoke the tofu for 90 minutes, flipping every 30 minutes.
At the 90 minute mark, baste the tofu with BBQ sauce and smoke for a final 30 minutes (optional)
